name: OpenTelemetry Observability
description: Traces, metrics, and logs for OpenClaw using OpenLLMetry and OpenTelemetry

protocol.label: OTLP Protocol
protocol.help: Use 'http' for OTLP/HTTP (port 4318) or 'grpc' for OTLP/gRPC (port 4317)

headers.label: OTLP Headers
headers.help: Custom headers for OTLP export (e.g., Authorization for Dynatrace)

captureContent.label: Capture Prompt/Completion Content
captureContent.help: Accepts `true` / `false` (legacy, all-on or all-off) or a granular ContentCapturePolicy object with the per-category flags `inputMessages`, `outputMessages`, `toolInputs`, `toolOutputs`, `systemPrompt`. Default is everything off.

sampleRate.label: Trace Sampling Rate
sampleRate.help: Optional head-based sampling rate from 0.0 to 1.0

signalEndpoints.label: Per-Signal OTLP Endpoints
signalEndpoints.help: Optional per-signal endpoint overrides for backends that expose separate ingestion URLs for metrics/logs/traces (e.g. IONOS Cloud Observability). Falls back to the shared `endpoint` for any signal left unset.

signalHeaders.label: Per-Signal OTLP Headers
signalHeaders.help: Optional per-signal header overrides (e.g. a different APIKEY per signal's pipeline). Replaces `headers` entirely for that signal when set.

endpoint.description: OTLP endpoint URL (e.g., http://localhost:4318 for HTTP, http://localhost:4317 for gRPC)

captureContent.description: Content capture policy. `true`/`false` toggle every category at once; an object selects categories individually. Unknown keys are tolerated by the parser and ignored at runtime. See docs/security/privacy.md.

inputMessages.description: Capture inbound user message text on the request/agent.turn spans.

outputMessages.description: Capture outbound assistant reply text on the message.sent span.

toolInputs.description: Capture full tool-call input arguments on the execute_tool span.

toolOutputs.description: Capture tool-call result text on the execute_tool span.

systemPrompt.description: Capture the system prompt on the agent.turn span.

sampleRate.description: Optional head-based trace sampling rate from 0.0 to 1.0

signalEndpoints.description: Optional per-signal OTLP endpoint overrides. Falls back to `endpoint` for any signal not listed.

signalHeaders.description: Optional per-signal header overrides. Replaces `headers` entirely for that signal when set.
